app.name: Dauys-Foto
app.tagline: Learn photo editing with your voice

auth.loginLead: Log in to get back to your photos.
auth.registerLead: Tell us your name, then pick a username and a password.
auth.toLogin: Already have an account? Log in

errors.username_taken: That username is taken. Try another one.
errors.username_invalid: Use only letters, numbers, dots or dashes in the username.
errors.passwords_differ: The passwords don't match. Try once more.
errors.password_short: The password needs at least 6 characters.
errors.login_failed: The username or password didn't match. Check them and try again.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check that the backend is running.
errors.upload_failed: That file couldn't be uploaded. Try a different picture.
errors.save_failed: The photo wasn't saved on the server, but you can still download it.
errors.chat_failed: The chat message didn't go through. The change to the photo is kept.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.background_failed: The background could not be removed. Try another tool.
errors.model_missing: The background model has not been downloaded yet. Ask a grown-up to download the models.

home.title: My photos
home.lead: Pick a photo and change it with your voice.

voice.idle: Press the microphone and say a command
voice.unclear: I couldn't catch a command. Please say it again.
voice.noSpeech: No voice came through. Press the microphone and try again.
voice.micBlocked: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in the browser, or use the buttons below.
voice.offline: Speech recognition isn't available right now. The buttons below still work.
voice.unsupported: This browser can't use the microphone. Use the buttons below.

other_command: {{effect}} Now let's go back to the task.
retry_heard: I heard “{{heard}}”, which isn't a command. Try saying “{{label}}”.
retry_unclear: I couldn't make out the words. Press the microphone and slowly say “{{label}}”.
I didn't catch any words this time. Let's try “{{label}}” once more.
free_retry_heard: I heard “{{heard}}”, which isn't a command. Try {{examples}}.
That sounded like “{{heard}}”. Say {{examples}} and the photo will change.
free_retry_unclear: I couldn't make out the words. Try {{examples}}.
I didn't catch any words this time. Let's try {{examples}}.
assistant.finished: You finished every task! Free mode is on: you can use any command now.
ai_edit: Here it is! If you like it, say “Keep it”; if not, “Go back”.
Done! Say “Keep it” if you like it.
ai_generate: Your new picture is ready! Say “Keep it” if you like it.
ai_kept: Lovely! The photo looks like this now.
ai_saved: Great! The new picture is saved in My photos.
ai_discarded: Okay, it's back the way it was. Try another idea.
Nothing changed. Let's think of something else.
assistant.ai_finished: You finished every AI Studio task! Now you can tell me any idea.
ai_refused: I can't draw that one. Let's try another idea, like “Make it snow”.
That's not something I can make. How about “Add a rainbow”?
ai_unclear: I didn't understand the idea. Try saying “Add a rainbow”.
ai_not_heard: I couldn't make out the words. Press the microphone and say your idea slowly.

help.title: What you can say
help.lead: Press the microphone and say one of these words. The speaker button reads a word aloud.

off.title: The AI Studio is not connected yet
off.text: A grown-up sets it up once; the README explains how. Until then, Edit mode works fully.

notice.title: For grown-ups
notice.text: In the AI Studio the photo and the child's words are sent to external services (Google Gemini, Cloudflare) to make pictures. Using the sample photos is best. If you agree, press the button.

ai.idle: Press the microphone and tell me your idea

choice.sayHint: You can also say “Keep it” or “Go back”.

problems.not_configured: The AI Studio is not connected yet. Edit mode works already.
problems.limit: That's all the AI requests for today. Let's try again tomorrow! You can keep playing in Edit mode.
problems.unavailable: The AI is not answering right now. Let's try a bit later; Edit mode still works.
problems.network: No internet connection. Edit mode works without it.

ai.saved: Your new picture is saved in My photos.

lesson.add: Add something to the picture. For example: “Add a rainbow”.
lesson.style: Change the picture's style. For example: “Turn it into a cartoon”.
lesson.remove: Take something away. For example: “Remove the sun”.
